ev.q: Similar to the earlier games in the Crysis series, Crysis 3 is a first-person shooter
a more discreet and stealthy approach
Players can also upgrade and customize their weapons and the Nanosuit
These upgrades can increase the suit's properties, and strengthen or unlock new abilities
There are 8 different modes, with a total of 12 available maps to play on
Crysis 3 is set in a post-apocalyptic New York City
The visuals and graphics of the game were widely praised by reviewers
short length of about six hours
